semantics: Bundle Thunk P4t assigns client token = new Date().getTime() and places the message in state.messages.sending[convoId]. For chatrooms (u=false), P4t ignores the POST HTTP response and starts a 6000ms watchdog timer. The frontend relies exclusively on WebSocket NEW_MESSAGE event handled by Tgr: when u (own message) and t.token are present, it dispatches UPDATE_MESSAGES_SENDING to remove the pending message and stop the spinner. If WebSocket does not provide token within 6000ms, watchdog triggers WEBSOCKET_CLOSE which forces fallback GET /api/v2/chatroom/<room>/ and clears sending.

evidence.symbol: P4t (send thunk), Tgr (WebSocket NEW_MESSAGE handler), sga (UPDATE_MESSAGES_SENDING reducer), Qfa (WEBSOCKET_CLOSE reducer)
